candidate_workaround: Use explicit remote-tracking refs for divergence probes instead of PowerShell-sensitive upstream shorthand.
failure_signature: A post-x1 PowerShell wrapper misparsed the upstream shorthand in a nonessential divergence display after equality was already proven.
recurrence_guard: Quote explicit refs/remotes/origin branch names in PowerShell divergence commands.
rollback: Give the malformed divergence display zero credit and do not retry any already completed push.
scope_boundary: Read-only Git equality recovery only; no scientific, production, identity, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Use explicit remote-tracking refs in PowerShell divergence probes
trigger_preconditions: A PowerShell command must compare the current head with its remote-tracking branch.
